Squid Game (Season 1).text: Creator Hwang Dong-hyuk wrote and directed it alone, and the stress cost him six teeth.
Squid Game (Season 1).evidence: Hwang wrote all of the season himself ... Hwang also addressed the physical and mental challenges in the creation of the season, saying that he had forgone dental health while making it, and had to have six teeth pulled by his dentist after production was complete.

Wednesday (Season 1).text: Fans recreated Wednesday's dance to Lady Gaga's "Bloody Mary" on TikTok, and Gaga herself joined in.
Wednesday (Season 1).evidence: Following the release of Wednesday, Wednesday Addams' dance from the series and its fan recreations to Lady Gaga's song "Bloody Mary" went viral on video sharing service TikTok, with Kim Kardashian, Amelia Dimoldenberg, Marina Diamandis, Madonna and Gaga herself also participating in the trend.

Squid Game (Season 2).text: Rapper T.O.P plays Thanos, a rapper ruined by a crypto scam, voted favorite new player by half of 700,000 fans.
Squid Game (Season 2).evidence: He would play the role of a former rapper, Thanos, fallen from grace due to a crypto scam. ... A survey held by Netflix asking about the new characters found that Thanos was the favorite of 50 percent of the 700,000 respondents

Squid Game (Season 3).text: Cate Blanchett appears in its last scene, as the recruiter for an American version of the games.
Squid Game (Season 3).evidence: Cate Blanchett makes a cameo appearance at the end of the final episode, she takes the role of a recruiter for an American version of the games.

Adolescence.text: Each hour-long episode is one continuous take, and each was shot about ten times, two takes a day.
Adolescence.evidence: Adolescence is noted for its extensive use of one-shot filming, as each episode is shot in one take by cinematographer Matthew Lewis. ... Each one-hour episode was shot around 10 times, with two takes per day.

Stranger Things (Season 4).text: Kate Bush, a fan of the show, let it use "Running Up That Hill", and the song's streams rose over 8,700%.
Stranger Things (Season 4).evidence: Felder learned Bush was a fan of the show, and after reviewing the script pages where the song would be used, Bush agreed to clear licensing rights to the song for the show. The song saw a resurgence of popularity with an increase of over 8,700% on streaming charts

Stranger Things (Season 5).text: Its series finale played in cinemas across the US and Canada on New Year's Eve 2025.
Stranger Things (Season 5).evidence: The series finale had a limited theatrical release in the United States and Canada with showtimes beginning the evening of December 31, 2025, and continuing through January 1, 2026.

Wednesday (Season 2).text: It brought in Steve Buscemi as Nevermore's new principal and Joanna Lumley as Grandmama.
Wednesday (Season 2).evidence: In April 2024, Steve Buscemi joined the cast of the second season as the new principal of Nevermore Academy ... with Buscemi portraying Barry Dort, Billie Piper as Isadora Capri, Joanna Lumley as Grandmama

Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story.text: Evan Peters wore lead weights on his hands in rehearsals to copy the stiff way Dahmer's arms moved.
Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story.evidence: He also studied Dahmer's posture and movements and wore led weights around his hands during rehearsals to reproduce the limited movement of Dahmer's arms when walking.

Bridgerton (Season 1).text: Its balls dance to string-quartet covers of pop hits, from "Thank U, Next" to Billie Eilish's "Bad Guy".
Bridgerton (Season 1).evidence: The first season featured orchestral covers of contemporary popular music ... Songs featured included Ariana Grande's "Thank U, Next", Maroon 5's "Girls Like You", Shawn Mendes's "In My Blood" and Billie Eilish's "Bad Guy", all four of which are performed by Vitamin String Quartet
